name: ASUS RT-BE7200
notes: ASUS publishes stock firmware for the RT-BE7200, but its page has no hardware table; do not copy the RT-BE88U hardware specs. Merlin uses the RT-BE88U image for this model.

ownership.label: AsusWrt-Merlin community firmware
ownership.details: AsusWrt-Merlin 3006.102.9_0 (2026-09-23) supports the RT-BE7200 through the RT-BE88U image; no RT-BE7200-named file exists.

supportRoutes.name: AsusWrt-Merlin
supportRoutes.description: AsusWrt-Merlin 3006.102.9_0 (2026-09-23) supports the RT-BE7200 through the RT-BE88U image; no RT-BE7200-named file exists.
requirements: Use the RT-BE88U Merlin image that the project lists for the RT-BE7200; upload it through the router web UI.
Reboot the router before flashing; low memory may cause an image rejection.
On ASUS stock 3.0.0.6.102_37000 or newer, the first Merlin flash may need the documented downgrade check over SSH.
No RT-BE7200-named Merlin file exists; the RT-BE88U image is shared, while stock firmware is separate.

supportRoutes.name: ASUS stock firmware
supportRoutes.description: ASUS lists 3.0.0.6.102_39451 dated 2026-10-21 for RT-BE7200 on its model support page.
requirements: Match RT-BE7200 exactly and check the model support page before downloading.
ASUS demonstrates Firmware Restoration separately as its rescue-mode route.

supportRoutes.name: Firmware Restoration
supportRoutes.description: ASUS documents Firmware Restoration for rescue mode. Its FAQ demonstrates the procedure on an RT-AC68U, so its LED timing is not confirmed for this model.
requirements: Unzip the stock firmware before using the utility; it cannot upload an archive.
Use a wired PC with the documented static IP, enter rescue mode by holding Reset while powering on, then restore the stock image.
